title: Session resume, logout UX & multi-device builds
summary: Keep-me-signed-in works after tab close; Sign out no longer double-prompts; homepage returns staff to console; Desktop 2.0.4 and Android 2.0.4 bundles.
highlights: Keep me signed in survives closing the browser tab
Single in-app Sign out dialog (no double system alerts)
Sticky signed-out flag fixed so auto-login works again
Desktop 2.0.4 + Android 2.0.4 with matching session fixes
